   - Source frames, source catalog, authority bindings, patient/product data, and parent release materials are completely isolated and never exposed to model prompt construction.

2. **Provider Transport & Schema Subset:**
   - Target configuration is strictly bound in [`contracts.py`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_contracts.py#L60-L76): project `bernie-emr4-dev`, service account `emr4-bernie-ai-dev@bernie-emr4-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, model `gemini-2.5-flash`, location `australia-southeast1`.
   - Generation parameters: `temperature: 0`, `candidateCount: 1`, `maxOutputTokens: 2048`, `thinkingBudget: 1024`.
   - Provider response schema [`provider_response_schema()`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_contracts.py#L372-L406) uses a strictly supported subset without `uniqueItems` or unsupported OpenAPI constructs. Tools, retrieval, cached content, and fallbacks are absent.

3. **Draft 2020-12 Validation & Grounding Proofreader:**
   - Local JSON schema [`provider-intent-body.schema.json`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/orchestration/continuity/raisa-authored-synthetic-model-required-practice-context-fabric-intent-shaping-rehearsal/provider-intent-body.schema.json) enforces `uniqueItems: true` on `cue_codes`, closed enums, and required property constraints.
   - Proofreader [`proofread_intent_candidate`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_contracts.py#L859-L930) enforces exact intent code, coordinate code, and cue code matching against `_expected_classification`, validates `_all_false` for all 8 authority flags, and verifies parent packet trace release decision `RELEASE`.

4. **Fresh Request Materialisation & Freshness Enforcement:**
   - Live requests are materialised fresh by [`_fresh_live_request`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_live.py#L175-L187) with exactly 600 seconds TTL (`LIVE_REQUEST_TTL_SECONDS`).
   - Broker independently validates freshness in [`_validate_live_request_freshness`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_broker.py#L137-L165), asserting timezone awareness, exact 600s duration, and `issued_at <= now < expires_at`. The provider-free request fixture remains static and deterministic.

5. **Correction Paths, Single-Use Ledgers & Cost Control:**
   - Schema-invalid bodies reach only `provider_body_schema_invalid` correction path via [`provider_body_rejection`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_contracts.py#L721-L745).
   - Single-use attempt ledger is consumed prior to provider call in [`_execute`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_broker.py#L229).
   - Hard ceilings enforced: max 2 calls total, USD 0.50 maximum cost.
   - Live occupied runs require positive thinking tokens via [`positive_thinking_evidence`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_contracts.py#L746-L760).
   - Attempt sequence terminates immediately upon candidate admission (`proofreader_verdict == "admitted"`).

6. **Release Integrity & Zeroisation Immutability:**
   - Release candidate is sealed in [`_build_release`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_contracts.py#L798-L832) using deep copies of the envelope, parent candidate, parent binding, parent catalog, and parent packet.
   - [`validate_release_integrity`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_contracts.py#L834-L857) re-verifies release seal, envelope seal, and parent contract seals.
   - Zeroisation of original working envelope/body does not alter released objects or invalidate seals.

7. **Tranche Evidence Sanitisation:**
   - Tranche evidence [`_tranche_evidence`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_live.py#L273-L340) retains only digest-bound attempt summaries [`_attempt_summary`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_live.py#L341-L412).
   - Raw prompts, responses, model text, and credentials are explicitly not retained (`raw_prompt_retained: false`, `raw_provider_response_retained: false`, `credential_or_token_retained: false`).

8. **Bounded Schemas & Fail-Closed Evidence:**
   - All 7 schemas verified for structural boundedness by [`_assert_schema_structurally_bounded`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_acceptance.py#L125-L143).
   - Zero-call dry-run evidence is labeled `provider_free_authored_synthetic_model_intent_shaping`, preventing masquerade as occupied evidence (`occupied_authored_synthetic_model_intent_shaping`).
   - Source review validation [`_validate_source_review`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_live.py#L232-L270) requires exact 13-file source hash alignment and clean tracked worktree.

9. **Container Security & Dry-Run Isolation:**
   - Reuses A3/B3 container isolation semantics (`--read-only`, no volume mounts, internal-only network, immediate post-attempt container/network destruction).
   - Dry-run mode executes broker logic without contacting network endpoints, using committed synthetic provider packet fixture.

10. **Closed Operational Boundary:**
    - AST static analysis [`_static_checks`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/context-fabric-model-intent-shaping-review/scripts/raisa_authored_synthetic_model_required_practice_context_fabric_intent_shaping_acceptance.py#L173-L234) confirms no forbidden network, subprocess, or database calls in contracts or acceptance scripts.
    - No GraphQL, REST, DB, product runtime, clinical, administrative, or deployment surfaces opened.
